description.value:
This sealed glass vial has no stopper and is filled with pure white light. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is [[/r 1d20+21 #spell attack roll]]{+21} and the spell DC is 31.

  • Armor After you cast an electricity spell by Activating the energizing vial, you can Step as a free action once per round until the end of your next turn.

  • Weapon After you cast an electricity spell by Activating the energizing vial, your Strikes with the weapon deal @Damage[1d6[persistent,electricity]] damage until the end of your next turn.
